ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious GoogleUpdate Child Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes of "GoogleUpdate.exe"

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\GoogleUpdate\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Google.*") OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\setup\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("chrome\\_updater\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("chrome\\_installer\\\.exe$"))) OR process_path = "None")
